key_teaching_points.explanation: 126 Exploring Society: India and Beyond | Grade 7 Part 2 In the chapter “Unity in Diversity, or ‘Many in the One’ ” (Grade 6 Social Science textbook), we read that “many Indians may be called migrants, in the sense of people not living near their birthplace or with their original community.” In this chapter, we will explore another type of migrants — people who came to India from other parts of the world and settled here, adding another dimension to the diversity.
